answer: Treat each identity as an island built in layers: every epoch it lays down a hash-committed stratum, basalt below and timber above, derived from its last layer plus a public unpredictable input, while neighbours keep copies of that layer's hash. Rewards scale with verified depth, not headcount. A sybil fleet starts with shallow cores anyone can drill; faking depth means actually computing and storing distinct layers per fake for years, and opening one random deep layer on demand exposes any retro-forged stack at once.
